{/* Dynamic Animated Watermark Background */}
NET_SENTINEL
{/* ========================================================= */} {/* PARTITION 1: HERO & PROJECT TITLE SECTION */} {/* ========================================================= */}
SYSTEM VERSION 2.4.0 // SOC THREAT RECONNAISSANCE ACTIVE

NETSENTINEL SOC INTELLIGENCE & RECON SUITE

A modular threat intelligence platform engineered to execute real-time network probes, resolve host telemetry, map active CVE vulnerabilities, and uncover exposed public web assets.

{/* ========================================================= */} {/* PARTITION 2: DEEP ABOUT PROJECT SECTION */} {/* ========================================================= */}

PROJECT ARCHITECTURE & DESIGN PURPOSE

NetSentinel SOC was created to eliminate black-box scanning by combining five specialized reconnaissance engines into a single cybersecurity dashboard. Built with a React frontend and Node.js microservices, the system performs live non-predescribed external probes, querying authoritative DNS servers, certificate transparency databases, and global CVE threat registries in real-time.

⚡ Real-Time API Engine

Zero static data. Connects dynamically to Shodan InternetDB, ip-api, and crt.sh live endpoints.

🛡️ Auth & Access Control

Enforces authentication gates. Requires analyst session validation before tool execution.

📊 Audit Log Persistence

Saves scan histories, exports comprehensive JSON reports, and tracks vulnerability trends over time.

{/* ========================================================= */} {/* PARTITION 3: INDIVIDUAL TOOL MODULES INTRODUCTION */} {/* ========================================================= */}

FIVE CORE RECONNAISSANCE MODULES

Click on any module to authenticate and run a targeted probe.

{/* Tool 1 */}
handleToolClick('host_info')}>

1. Domain Host & IP Geolocation Intel

Resolves web hostnames to precise IPv4 addresses. Fetches ASN details, internet service providers (ISP), country/city geolocations, and hosting network registry data.

RUN HOST PROBE
{/* Tool 2 */}
handleToolClick('port_threat')}>

2. Port Scanner & CVE Threat Evaluator

Queries Shodan InternetDB to detect open network ports (HTTP, SSH, FTP, Database ports) and flags known Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs).

RUN PORT PROBE
{/* Tool 3 */}
handleToolClick('subdomain_dns')}>

3. Subdomain Enumerator & DNS Mapping

Performs passive subdomain discovery by analyzing public Certificate Transparency (CT) logs via crt.sh to index active host names and DNS configurations.

RUN ENUMERATOR
{/* Tool 4 */}
handleToolClick('dir_exposure')}>

4. Directory Bruteforce & Confidential File Probe

Inspects web roots for exposed sensitive files (`.env`, `.git`, `robots.txt`, `sitemap.xml`) and flags dangerous HTTP 200 OK configuration leaks.

RUN DIRECTORY PROBE
{/* Tool 5 */}
handleToolClick('ssl_audit')}>

5. SSL Certificate & Security Header Auditor

Audits SSL/TLS encryption certificates for validity and checks defensive HTTP headers like HSTS, Content-Security-Policy (CSP), and X-Frame-Options.

RUN HEADER AUDIT
